Load Official Twitter Archive

X only displays up to 3,200 tweets on web profiles. To delete your entire account history, import the official tweets.js file exported from X.

📁
Drag and drop tweets.js here or click to select from your computer

How to download your archive from X:

  1. On X, go to More > Settings and privacy > Your account > Download an archive of your data.
  2. Wait for the confirmation email from X and extract the .zip file.
  3. Open the data/ folder and select the tweets.js file.
